sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:34

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:34:1
items.html:
Badak Haya etc. are the posteriors of AVI: This alludes to the phase of the revealed NHY, which are the posterior of AVI, as above. For Badak means correction, from the expression Bedek HaBayit [the repair of the House]. Haya means the light of Hochma, for the light of Hochma is called Haya, as is known. And since the whole merit of these NHY is the illumination of Hochma in them, as above, they are therefore alluded to by the name Badak Haya, meaning the correction of Hochma in Hassadim. And understand this.
And there is a second reason why they are alluded to by the letters Badak Haya. It is that these posteriors of AVI fell into the place of ZON, so that afterwards, at the time of the correction, ZA makes sortings out of these posteriors and raises them as MAN [female waters] to AVI; and through this MAN, AVI couple face to face and bestow Mochin upon ZA. And all the Mochin of ZA come by means of the MAN that rise from these posteriors. Therefore they are called Badak Haya, after the correction of the Mochin of GAR [first three] of ZA that comes by means of them; for Badak is an expression of correction, and Haya is the light of Hochma and Mochin, as above.
